question: Should OpenClaw define the QQBot gateway inbound limit at 1 MiB despite the official protocol publishing no maximum, or use a larger bounded value for compatibility headroom?
rationale: The mechanism and proof are strong, but the numeric cutoff is a user-impacting fail-closed policy that source, tests, and official documentation cannot determine.

options.title: Use a larger bounded limit
options.body: Select a cap with more compatibility margin based on representative QQBot traffic or channel-owner knowledge while still avoiding the 100 MiB dependency default.

options.title: Accept 1 MiB
options.body: Keep the submitted cutoff and explicitly own rejection and reconnect behavior for any larger legitimate event.

recommendation.title: Use a larger bounded limit
recommendation.body: Select a cap with more compatibility margin based on representative QQBot traffic or channel-owner knowledge while still avoiding the 100 MiB dependency default.
